TAAF Arrêté n° 2025-111: ordinary international letter or postcard up to 20 g to Germany and most world destinations costs 2.10 EUR from 1 January 2026. Arrêté n° 2026-94 sets the same international 20 g tariff at 2.25 EUR from 1 January 2027 (pre-published, not yet in force on 18 Nov 2026). Separate preferential / internal tariff to mainland France and French territories: 1.39 EUR in 2026, 1.52 EUR in 2027 (up to 20 g). The 2027 order replaces the 2026 order effective 1 Jan 2027. Both official documents are hosted by taaf.fr; see scheduled_source_url for the 2027 PDF. Ordinary letters only, not registered.

rates.notes: Current Russian Post international ordinary, unregistered letter tariff for Germany and all countries except Belarus and Kazakhstan: 140 RUB non-priority / 160 RUB priority, up to 20 g, effective 1 September 2026. Prices are quoted for postage paid by stamps (without VAT). The 135 RUB ARGE Polarphilatelie listing from June 2026 is no longer current for this route. Russian Post officially lists tariff order no. 231-p of 13 August 2026, effective 1 September 2026, at the official tariffs index. Exact numerical amounts corroborated by 2026 Postmania (18 September) and Postcrossing community, but the original official PDF could not be directly retrieved for independent verification. Special 110/135 RUB tariffs apply to Belarus/Kazakhstan, not Germany. Check route availability separately: https://info.pochta.ru/support/no-mail-exchange. Reference: https://postmania.ru/post-tariffs

check.detail: Official tariff regulation exists but original amount table could not be independently reviewed; amounts are corroborated by current nonofficial sources.
